## ANTI-AI-SLOP
Arbitrary Tailwind values found bypassing the very tokens it introduces.

## FINDINGS
This PR establishes great design baselines and an auditor tool! Ironically, however, it contains numerous arbitrary Tailwind violations (`text-[8px]`, hardcoded spacing, etc.) within the auditor script/UI itself. Please refactor these usages into strict layout primitives and token values per Rule #1 so we can merge this in as the ultimate design arbiter without corrupting our own repo.

## FINAL RECOMMENDATION
Not Approved
